name: Shanda
summary: In Aldrassil, Shanda guides young night elf priests in the ways of Elune. She serves the Sisterhood of Elune in Shadowglen, teaching prayers, wards, and rites as her students prepare to defend Teldrassil.

sections.title: Acolyte of the Moon Mother
sections.body: Shanda guides young night elves devoted to Elune from within Aldrassil. While druids tend Teldrassil's roots and boughs, priestesses keep the Kaldorei close to the White Lady. Shanda teaches new initiates to call on lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the World Tree's boughs.

sections.title: Guiding New Initiates
sections.body: Young priests who awaken to their calling in Shadowglen come to Shanda to prove their devotion and learn their first prayers. Through rites such as In Favor of Elune, she tests their resolve, gives them blessed regalia, and teaches basic incantations. Her students learn to tend the wounded with a gentle hand and stand firm against the shadows.

faq.answer: Shanda trains night elf priests inside Aldrassil, the central hollow tree settlement of Shadowglen in Teldrassil. She teaches newly awakened priests the ways of the Sisterhood of Elune.

faq.q: What role does Shanda play for new priests?
faq.answer: Shanda teaches novice priests basic prayers, curative spells, and protective magic gifted by Elune. New priests bring her their Hallowed Sigil, and she sends them on to the next stage of training through In Favor of Elune.
Shanda is on the ground level inside Aldrassil's hollow trunk in Shadowglen, Teldrassil.

faq.q: What organization does Shanda belong to?
aliases: is shanda a priestess of the moon
faq.answer: Shanda belongs to the Sisterhood of Elune, the ancient order of night elf priestesses that has guided Kaldorei spiritual and cultural life for thousands of years.

angles.text: As a night elf priest beginning in Shadowglen, you can turn to Shanda for sacred words and guidance in Elune's grace.
As a night elf, you inherit the Sisterhood of Elune's tradition. Shanda tends to the spiritual well-being of Kaldorei youth taking their first steps on Teldrassil.
